annotations.title: Edit campaign draft targeting and ads

description: Low-level edit of a campaign draft before publishing: merge targeting keys, update ads, replace ad groups, rename, change goal, budget or UTM. Nothing is sent to the platform. Amounts are in the ad account's own currency, in whole units (not cents or micros).

ad_groups.description: Full replacement of the ad groups.

budget_amount.description: Budget in the account currency, whole units.

targeting.description: Targeting keys to merge; a null value removes the key.

name: campaign_draft_edit
